# Baseline timing sheet — template

Record how long these tasks take **today**, before Compass, with 2–3 design partners
(roadmap 1.9). This is the "before" number the 6-month metric is measured against
(`docs/V1_CORPUS_AND_METRIC.md`).

Method: ask each partner to time themselves (or narrate while you time) on a real instance
of each task. Don't average away the outliers — note them.

| Task | Partner | Date | Time taken | Systems they opened | What made it slow | Was the answer complete? |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Prepare for a renewal decision (pull projection vs. actual, past concerns, relationship history for one grant) | | | | | | |
| Pull every reported outcome for one fund / cohort | | | | | | |
| Answer "have we ever funded X" (a thesis area or approach) | | | | | | |
| Find why we declined a specific applicant | | | | | | |
| Assemble a one-page grantee dossier for a board deck | | | | | | |
| Check what a grantee reported last quarter vs. what they projected | | | | | | |
| Find a candid internal assessment of a grantee's leadership | | | | | | |

## What to capture beyond the number

- **The current workaround** — Salesforce/GivingData reports? a spreadsheet? asking a colleague? memory?
- **Where they gave up** — questions they *don't* ask today because it's too much work
- **The trust cost** — times they acted on an incomplete answer and it went wrong

## After Compass (repeat at 3 and 6 months)

Same tasks, same partners. The target: a renewal-prep task that took ~half a day takes
~1 hour, and the "questions they don't ask" list shrinks.
